body.objective: Improve the x402 exact purchase capability by adding exact exported request, receipt, refusal, and state schemas that its executable consumes for runtime admission and output construction. Preserve ERC-1271 payer identity, explicit CAIP-2 network selection, exact integer atomic settlement amounts, attenuated OCapN authority, exactly-once paid invocation, repeatable read-only observation, and the absence of an invented completion deadline.
constraints: Runtime code must consume the schemas; do not add inert schema documents
Do not introduce direct EOA payer identity
Do not use decimal monetary arithmetic
Do not add a universal completion timeout
Keep chain, RPC, resource, price, polling, and custody bindings parameterized
Preserve unknown values rather than coercing them to zero

testVectors.when: the executable admits, executes, observes, and returns the operation
then: malformed input is refused by the exported request contract
receipt and state carriers are constructed through exported contracts
all exact monetary amounts remain integer strings or rational numerator/denominator pairs
